description.en: Great juice selection and laid back staffs.
Awesome folks, awesome products.
The staff here are some of the best around.  They are extremely helpful and knowledgable.  Ben's shops have a huge selection of tasty vapes and lots of gear.
Great selection and excellent prices. Casual environment. Great place to relax and vape. The couches are super comfortable!

One year smoke free for my wife and I! This place has a welcoming vibe that other vape locations don't. The owners and employees are relaxed and never try to hard sell you. The quality of their mods and selection of their juices are top notch. They are always more than willing to tell you about the new flavors and keep you up to date on the newest technology. The general manager Adam has helped everyone I've sent there open their eyes to what the vaping community is all about. I highly recommend anyone who is a long time Vaper or curious about vaping in general to stop on down. Their guys will take care of you!
Awesome customer service and excellent product

This place is literally the best place for vape in all of Green Bay. I actually live in Georgia, but I’m a truck driver that works out of GB, and I’ve been to a lot of vape shops all over the country. This is hands down, my favorite of them all. They’re always willing to take their time with you to figure out what juice, hardware, product, etc works best for you and your preferences. They’re also willing to give you the best value for what you’re looking for and they don’t try to sell you something just because it costs more. This is my go to shop every time I’m in Green Bay.

It is a good place. Most of the employees are knowledgeable and super friendly, but there have been one or two that practically ignored me when I walk in. Which was kind of frustrating when I would ask a question, and promptly get blown off. I enjoyed the majority of the staff to keep going back though. Their good employees definitely make up for those one or two that give you problems. At least in my opinion.

Johnny Vapes is moving up on my favorite smoke shops. They have a nice open setting. The employees are friendly, helpful, but also not hovering. The employees also have so much knowledge about their products which I love. The choices of disposables are different and some of them I haven't seen around so it was cool to see the variety!

They also are pretty chill, got drinks and such on hand. There's some couches in there too. Their prices are reasonable for sure!

I really do like this store compared to Manitowoc. There's absolutely nothing wrong with the Manitowoc store but I feel like green bays has a little more to offer. Ping pong table and relaxed environment helps when choosing the right juice. The guys are great at both locations. I won't go to another store to buy my juices. Found out I like their polices, their demeanor, and the environment!

Clean and exciting store design, quality products, competitive pricing, and compassionate customer service have made me a return customer year after year.

I recently was in need of a new vape and Jason at the east side location was more than helpful. He went through every specification I cared about on every model that I was looking at. He gave his honest opinion on the devices he owned as well. I was able to purchase my best vape yet and am enjoying it very much.

Thank you for taking the extra time with me Jason! I will be back for more!
